This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Dinners That Pay My Rent, Episode 1: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken Pasta 🍗🍝 Crispy skin-on chicken over penne in a creamy garlic parmesan sauce, all in one pan. Ready in about 30 minutes. Ingredients: - 2 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs - Salt & black pepper, to taste - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp paprika - 4-5 oz penne pasta (about 2 cups dry) For the sauce: - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 garlic cloves, minced - 1/4 cup chicken broth - 2/3 cup heavy cream - 1/4 cup parmesan, freshly grated, plus more for topping - Squeeze of lemon juice (about 1/4 lemon) - Fresh parsley, chopped - 1/2 cup reserved pasta water Steps: 1. Pat the thighs completely dry and season both sides with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. 2. Put a pot of well-salted water on to boil for the pasta. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat and place the chicken skin-side down. Cook 6-8 minutes without moving it, until the skin is golden and crispy. 4. Flip and cook another 5-7 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C inside). Remove and set aside to rest. 5. Cook the penne 1 minute less than the package says. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water before draining. 6. Lower the skillet heat. Add the butter to the same pan, then the garlic — cook just until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Don't let it brown. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom. 8. Add the heavy cream and parmesan. Simmer 3-5 minutes until it thickens. 9. Toss the drained pasta into the sauce and cook together 1-2 minutes, adding splashes of the pasta water until the sauce is glossy and coats every piece. 10. Squeeze the lemon juice over the pasta, then place the chicken on top. 11. Finish with parsley and extra parmesan, and enjoy! #garlic #butter #chicken #pasta #easyrecipe

Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! 🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Chicken Pot Pie Over Biscuits  Ingredients:  4 tablespoons butter  1 medium yellow onion, chopped  1/4 cup all purpose flour  1 tablespoon minced garlic  2 cups Food Lion chicken broth  1 Food Lion chicken bouillon cube  1 cup milk  1 bag Food Lion frozen mixed vegetables  1 Food Lion rotisserie chicken, shredded  8 ounces Food Lion cheddar cheese, freshly grated  Food Lion biscuits  Seasonings, to taste:  Onion Powder Garlic Powder Celery Salt Dried Parsley Black Pepper  Directions:  Preheat the oven and bake the biscuits according to the package directions.  Shred the Food Lion rotisserie chicken and set aside.  Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.  Add the flour and minced garlic. Stir well and cook for about 2 minutes. Slowly pour in the chicken broth, stirring until smooth and well combined.  Add the chicken bouillon cube and season with onion powder, garlic powder, celery salt, dried parsley, and black pepper. Pour in the milk and stir until combined.  Add the frozen mixed vegetables, shredded rotisserie chicken, and freshly grated cheddar cheese. Stir until the cheese melts and everything is combined.  Cover the skillet and let the filling cook for 5 minutes.  Place the warm biscuits in bowls and spoon the creamy chicken pot pie filling over the top. ✨Chicken Casserole ✨ Sometimes you just need a comforting, one-pan dinner that makes the whole house smell amazing. This chicken casserole is rustic, simple, and loaded with tender chicken, veggies, and a delicious sauce with wine and herbs. Perfect for a wholesome midweek dinner or make ahead as even better the next day 👌🏻 ⸻ Ingredients • 4 chicken breasts • 3 carrots chopped • 2 celery stalks • 1 large onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 3 medium potatoes, peeled and diced • 2 tbsp plain flour • 250 ml white wine • 500 ml chicken stock • 1 tsp dried thyme •. 1 tsp parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil or butter • Salt & black pepper, to taste ⸻ Instructions 1. Brown the chicken – Heat the olive oil or butter in a heavy casserole dish. Season the chicken with salt and pepper, then sear until lightly golden. Remove and set aside. 2. Soften the veggies – In the same pan, sauté the onion, carrots, celery, garlic, for about 5 minutes until they begin to soften. 3. Make the base – Sprinkle over the flour and stir well. Pour in the wine, letting it bubble for a minute as you scrape up all the tasty browned bits. 4. Add stock & herbs – Stir in the chicken stock, thyme, and return the chicken to the dish. Add on potatoes. Bring to a simmer. 5. Slow cook – Cover and cook gently on the stovetop for 35–40 minutes until the chicken is tender and the potatoes are cooked through. 6. Finish & serve – Adjust seasoning with extra salt and pepper if needed. ⸻ Serve hot with crusty bread to mop up the sauce. #chickencasserole #comfortfood #cosy #irishcooking #chickendinner
